fr.elements: Main Residence; Vehicle Parking Area; Front Entry Area; Walkway; Landscaped Area; Open Lawn Area; Detached Structure
fr.considerations: Multiple Access Points; Limited Rear Access; Vegetation Near Structure
fr.recommendations:
• Mark the driveway entrance with reflective address numbers visible from the road in both directions.
• Keep a clear path between the front entry and the street free of parked vehicles and landscaping obstructions.
• Trim vegetation near the detached structure to maintain a clear walking path around all sides.
• Keep the rear access point unlocked and clearly marked so responders can reach the back of the property without returning to the front.
• Mark or sign the secondary access point so responders arriving for the first time can identify it quickly.
• Remove or relocate any vehicles parked in a way that blocks movement between the main residence and the detached structure.
• Keep the walkway from the parking area to the front entry clear of planters, equipment, or landscape features that would slow movement while carrying equipment.

wildfire.conditions: Tree Cluster; Scattered Shrubs; Adequate Vegetation Separation; Open Terrain; Scattered Shrubs; Multiple Access Routes; Vegetation Near Structure; Open Green Space
wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim trees in the cluster closest to the structure to create open space between the canopy and the building.
• Remove shrubs growing directly against or within a few feet of the structure walls.
• Thin scattered shrubs near the structure so they are not touching or closely grouped together.
• Keep the ground beneath the tree cluster clear of dead leaves, branches, and loose plant material.
• Maintain open gaps between individual shrubs scattered across the property so they are not connected to one another.
• Keep all access routes clear of overhanging branches and low-hanging limbs that could block a vehicle.
